messages:
claire: Quick convo re: lexicon - internal console uses 'Docs', marketing uses 'Help Center', legal uses 'Knowledge Base'. Should we standardize?
ben: I'd vote for 'Docs' in the UI; short and dev-friendly. Keep 'Help Center' for marketing.
ado: Agree. Also how to label links in-panel? 'Open guide' vs 'Read in docs' - need consistency.
claire: Suggest rule: top-level nav = 'Docs', consumer-facing banners = 'Help Center', CTAs inside panels = 'Open <topic> guide'.
ben: Telemetry: prefer ?utm_source=console over custom src param so analysts can use existing dashboards. Thoughts?
ado: Lean ?src=console for privacy reasons (shorter, no tracking cookies). Can we map both server-side?
claire: We'll standardize on ?src=console and add a server-side normalization to translate to utm_source when ingesting analytics.
docs-bot: Note: docs metadata PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/420 (adds short title frontmatter).
ben: small a11y: external-link icon with offscreen '(opens in new tab)' and aria-label. panel should close on nav.
claire: I'll update the design tokens and the console copy spreadsheet. Filing follow-ups: design token, docs frontmatter, analytics mapping, a11y checklist. thx :raised_hands:
summary: Align lexicon: use 'Docs' in console nav, 'Help Center' for marketing, contextual CTAs as 'Open <topic> guide', standardize ?src=console for telemetry with server-side mapping to utm, add external-link accessible hints, close panel on navigation, and follow-up tickets for tokens and docs metadata.
